label: Family overview to check-in
negative_prompt: hard cuts, heavy blur, low quality, distorted text, invented signs, fake QR code, new gate numbers, extra signage, warped illustration, jitter
prompt: Create a smooth 5 second continuous camera glide from the full Hong Kong airport family-route overview into the L7 check-in and bag-drop frame. The motion should feel like sliding across one infinite airport route map, not a crossfade. Follow the family route from the lower origin toward check-in counters, with the dotted route staying stable and legible. clean HKIA-style isometric airport route map, mobile 9:16, white and pale-blue architecture, dark blue dotted passenger route, numbered route markers, premium travel assistant look. Do not invent flight times, fixed gate numbers, retail brands, extra signs, or dense text. End exactly on the destination frame composition.
